_note: Condition keys as the harness writes them into records, with the paper's names. Edit `name` to rename everywhere (report.py, serve.py, env/run.ts read this).

conditions.name: raw
conditions.what: one LDraw file in one shot, no environment

conditions.name: raw+feedback
conditions.what: up to four files; the validator's report pasted back as text between them

conditions.name: env
conditions.what: the environment and connection language; each placement checked as it is made, the finished build never verified

conditions.name: env+gates
conditions.what: env, plus the validator at completion with two repair rounds per gate

conditions.name: env+full
conditions.what: env+gates, plus the validator as tools the agent may call during the build

models._note: The model ids the environment accepts (lib/copilot/types.ts COPILOT_MODELS); any other id silently falls back to claude-sonnet-5 there. The paper used claude-opus-5. The ldraw conditions call the Anthropic API directly, so the gemini id does not apply to them.
